# Enes Sakalli

Enes Sakalli, also known as Enes Berk Sakalli, is a bioinformatician, researcher, software developer, musician, and visual artist based in Vienna, Austria.

## Primary URLs

- Website: https://enesberksakalli.github.io/
- About: https://enesberksakalli.github.io/about.html
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=N-sKeu4AAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0009-5027-2470
- GitHub: https://github.com/enesBerkSakalli
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/enes-berk-sakalli-33856b150/
- CIBIV profile: https://www.cibiv.at/people/enes/
- University of Vienna profile: https://ufind.univie.ac.at/en/person.html?id=105740
- LBI-NetMed profile: https://netmed.lbg.ac.at/team/enes-sakalli/

## Research Identity

- Name variants: Enes Sakalli, Enes Berk Sakalli
- Google Scholar profile ID: N-sKeu4AAAAJ
- ORCID: 0009-0009-5027-2470
- Affiliations referenced on the site: Center for Integrative Bioinformatics Vienna, University of Vienna, Ludwig Boltzmann Institute for Network Medicine

## Main Research and Software

- Phylo-Movies: browser-based scientific visualization tool for animating topological changes between phylogenetic trees from sliding-window analyses.
- Phylo-Movies URL: https://enesberksakalli.github.io/phylo-movies/
- Phylo-Movies source: https://github.com/enesBerkSakalli/phylo-movies
- Phylo-Movies preprint: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.01.715821
- University of Vienna thesis: Sequential animation of phylogenetic trees, 2022, DOI 10.25365/thesis.71559, https://utheses.univie.ac.at/detail/62915
- SatuTe article: When the Past Fades: Detecting Phylogenetic Signal with SatuTe, Molecular Biology and Evolution, 2025, DOI 10.1093/molbev/msaf090
- Visual art: Scales across Frames, Ludwig Boltzmann Institute for Network Medicine, 2025, https://art.lbi-netmed.com/
